content: प्रमाथः .²1 Excessive paining, tormenting, torturing. .²2 Agitating, churning. .²3 Killing, slaughter, destruction, सैनिकानां प्रमाथेन सत्यमोजायितं त्वया <ls>U. 5. 31</ls>, <ls n="U.">4</ls>. .²4 Violence, outrage. .²6 Rape, forcible abduction. .{@-थाः@} {%m.%} (<ab>pl.</ab>) Epithet of the fiends attendant upon Śiva.
